about: Camera-move presets (the shot form's Camera): the move a shot's `camera:` line starts with (its amplitude and speed are added after), each with a sample clip, the same street rendered with that move (img/camera/<id>.mp4, made by tools/make_preset_samples.py on the series' video model). A sample is drawn the way the H3 prompt guide writes motion (the move, its amplitude and speed, and what it travels toward or reveals): `sample` gives its camera line, and the framing (`size`) and action it starts from when the defaults (wide; the woman by the bench) don't suit the move. The tile still hands over the plain move A big move over three seconds flickers on H3 (every fourth frame: its latents), so a sample can run longer (`dur`) at a smaller amplitude `base`: rendered on H3's base preset (20 steps, no turbo LoRA, no SLA attention), which makes a big move whole where the turbo leaves it faint or flickering; `location` and `plate`: a place of its own for the sample (a POV wants a long view ahead), its plate drawn from `plate`.

sample.camera: pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed, revealing the whole street, the cafe and the bench around her
sample.action: It opens close on a woman in a red wool coat, her face and shoulders filling the frame, as she waits by the bench outside the cafe.

sample.camera: pans left at slow speed from the cafe front along the street, revealing the row of houses beyond
pans right at slow speed from the cafe front along the street, revealing the row of houses beyond
tilts down with large amplitude at slow speed from the rooftops and the evening sky down to her standing by the bench
trucks left with large amplitude at slow speed along the cafe front, the street lamp in the foreground sliding across the frame
trucks right with large amplitude at slow speed along the cafe front, the street lamp in the foreground sliding across the frame
pedestals up at slow speed, rising from the wet cobbles to look down on her and the street from above the awning

sample.action: It opens high above the street, looking down on the striped awning, the bench and a woman in a red wool coat waiting beside it.
sample.camera: pedestals down with large amplitude at slow speed, descending from above the awning to eye level beside her

sample.plate: A long narrow cobbled street at dusk seen at eye level from the middle of the street, looking straight down its length to a vanishing point, wet cobbles shining, shop windows and cafe fronts glowing warm on both sides, street lamps lit, no people
sample.action: Walking down the middle of the wet cobbled street, seen through her own eyes: the street stretches ahead to a vanishing point, shop windows glowing on both sides slide past; no one stands in front of the camera.
sample.camera: moves forward at walking pace down the middle of the street, bobbing gently with each step
